name: CSS Border Radius Generator
summary: Build border-radius CSS with linked or per-corner controls, units, and optional elliptical radii — live preview.
description: Tune corner radii with linked or individual sliders, switch between px / % / rem, and optionally set elliptical (horizontal / vertical) radii. Copy a ready border-radius declaration. Preview updates live in your browser.

faqs.question: What does Link corners do?
faqs.answer: One slider sets all four corners to the same radius. Uncheck it to control each corner separately.

faqs.question: What is elliptical mode?
faqs.answer: It outputs the two-radius form (horizontal / vertical), useful for pill-like or oval corners.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
